clue.text: Selected ministers' furniture

explanation.surface: Senior members of government own some furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: The senior ministers chosen to run a government form its inner council, and a cupboard with shelves or drawers is a piece of furniture of the same name.

clue.text: Beats hot meals

explanation.surface: Something outdoes spicy dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: To curry is an old verb for thrashing or drubbing, and spicy Indian-style dishes are the familiar noun sense.

clue.text: A liberal split over time involving more than one party?

indicators.note: split says the letters of the words are broken apart and set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A Liberal Party member breaks ranks for a while over a deal between factions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'split' rearranges A LIBERAL together with T for time; 'over' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-sided agreement is one made between two parties, so it involves more than one.

clue.text: Reign over this republic

indicators.note: over, as in knocked over, says the letters of the word before it fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A monarch's rule ends in this country, which became a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' rearranges REIGN; 'this' merely points at the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The West African state is a republic with a president rather than a monarch.

clue.text: Quartet in cassette trade scandal

indicators.note: in says the letters wanted sit inside the run of words that follows, across the gap between cassette and trade

explanation.surface: A pop group is caught up in a scandal over tape sales.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'scandal' as the definition, but a scandal is no set of four: 'Quartet' is the definition and 'in' points into cassette trade, with 'scandal' only dressing the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of four things is a tetrad, just as a group of four players is a quartet.

clue.text: Representative in cruel new collapse

indicators.note: in puts the piece for the representative inside the rearranged letters
new says the letters of cruel are made over into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: an MP, a Member of Parliament, represents a constituency

explanation.surface: A politician falls apart in a harsh new regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Representative' suggests a delegate, but it is the standard crossword MP; 'new' rearranges the cruel letters into CRULE, and 'in' sets the politician inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To crumple is to fold up or give way, as a person or structure does when it collapses.

clue.text: Instrument, first noticed in new article

indicators.note: in places that opening letter inside the reworked letters of article
new says the letters of article are made over into a fresh order
first picks out the opening letter of the word noticed

explanation.surface: An instrument is mentioned for the first time in a new piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns ARTICLE into CLARIET; 'first' takes N from noticed and 'in' sets it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A clarinet is a single-reed woodwind instrument.

clue.text: Tune playing on opening night can become impossible to support

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of tune are performed in a new arrangement
the opening of night is its first letter

parts.note: to be able is to be able to, that is, can

explanation.surface: Hearing a tune on a show's first night can be unbearable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges TUNE into UNTE; 'opening' takes N from night; 'on' and 'become' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A position that cannot be defended or upheld is untenable.

clue.text: Wall mounting team selected?

explanation.surface: A display on the wall shows the chosen side.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat board fixed to a wall is a panel, and a group of chosen experts or judges is also called a panel.

clue.text: Directions to underground chamber put into code

parts.note: E and N are the abbreviations for the compass points east and north
a crypt is a vault beneath a church

explanation.surface: Instructions for reaching a vault are written in cipher.
explanation.definitionFit: To render a message in cipher so others cannot read it is to encrypt it.

clue.text: The Spanish in correct position to open fire again?

indicators.note: in puts the Spanish word inside the word for the correct position

parts.note: the right position is the correct one
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: Spanish troops take up position correctly so as to resume shooting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'open fire' reads as shooting, but here a fire is lit once more; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To relight a fire or stove is to start it burning once more after it has gone out.

clue.text: Effect of radiation found intact in ice crystals

indicators.note: found says the letters wanted are found inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Radiation damage has been discovered in ice that is otherwise unbroken.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the end of intact and stretches into ice; 'crystals' only dresses the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Actinic describes light or radiation able to cause chemical change, as in photography, so it names that effect.

clue.text: In total, covering one train crash in every country

indicators.note: covering says the first phrase goes round the other letters

parts.note: in tally, that is, all counted up together, means in total

indicators.note: a crash wrecks the letters of one train into a new order

explanation.surface: Altogether, news of a rail disaster has spread across the globe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash' turns ONE TRAIN into ERNATION, which 'covering' puts after the T of IN TALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done internationally is done across nations, throughout the world.

clue.text: Light way to dress?

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
to robe someone is to dress them

explanation.surface: A question about a casual way to get dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light' looks like an adjective about clothing, but it is the noun for a flashing lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A strobe is a flashing lamp, a kind of light used in clubs and photography.

clue.text: Support hospital facilities in disarray after wicked lie

annotationWithheld.clue: Support hospital facilities in disarray after wicked lie

clue.text: Most ineffective bet feels wrong

indicators.note: wrong says the letters of bet feels are put in the wrong order and must be fixed

explanation.surface: A gambler feels a wager is wasted.
explanation.definitionFit: The weakest or least effective of all is the feeblest.

clue.text: In time ale goes off — get rid of it

indicators.note: goes off suggests the letters spoil and turn into a new order

explanation.surface: Beer left long enough turns sour, so throw it away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes off' rearranges IN TIME ALE; 'it' completes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To eliminate something is to remove it entirely.

clue.text: You'd be naked without one of these

definitions.text: You'd be naked without one of these

parts.words: You'd be naked without one of these
parts.note: the idiom not a single piece of thread worn means naked, so the clue describes what you lack when nude

explanation.surface: A remark about what keeps you decent.
explanation.walkthrough: The common phrase for being nude says you have not a single sewn piece on, so the cryptic reading lifts the last two words of that phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with nothing on at all is said to have not a single sewn item covering them.

clue.text: Weak tea, delicious brew with no requests for payment

indicators.note: brew says the letters of tea, delicious are stirred into a new mixture

parts.note: IOUs are written promises to pay, which call in a debt

explanation.surface: A pale cup of tea is tasty and free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brew' mixes the letters of tea, delicious; 'with no' takes away IOUS, leaving the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fragile or frail, easily broken or hurt, is delicate.

clue.text: Hearing low-level result, reduce quality

indicators.note: Hearing says the phrase is to be judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a D grade is a poor mark in an exam

explanation.surface: Being told of a poor exam mark lowers the standard.
explanation.walkthrough: D GRADE is a poor exam result; spoken, it sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To degrade something is to lower its standard or worsen it.

clue.text: Show notes to northerner

parts.note: D and E are musical notes
the Picts were an ancient people of northern Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone shows musical notes to a person from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict is to represent or portray, as in a picture.

clue.text: A little rod-wriggler?

parts.note: a tad is a little bit
a pole is a long rod

explanation.surface: A short fishing rod wiggles in the water.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen joins the rod to the wriggler only on the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A frog's larva swims by flicking its tail, a wriggling creature.

clue.text: Twigs way to get badly sick

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: badly says the letters of sick are put out of order

explanation.surface: Branches might make you feel quite ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges SICK into ICKS; 'to get' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Small thin pieces of branch gathered from trees are sticks.

clue.text: Blown off the picture

explanation.surface: Something was blown away from the image.
explanation.definitionFit: Something carried off by a gust has vanished on the breeze, and the 1939 Hollywood epic starring Vivien Leigh is the famous film of that title.

clue.text: Back good Parisian, the French aristocrat, maybe

indicators.note: Back says the French word for good is read the other way round

parts.note: bon is French for good
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Supporting a fine Frenchman, the French aristocrat perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns BON into NOB.
explanation.definitionFit: A noble is a member of the titled class, so a peer is an example of one.

clue.text: Improve morality, perhaps, in bed if you like

indicators.note: in says the letters wanted sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Perhaps, if you like, morals can be raised in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the end of bed and stretches through if into you; 'like' only dresses the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To edify is to instruct someone in a way that lifts them morally or intellectually.

clue.text: When the issue first came to light?

definitions.text: When the issue first came to light?

parts.words: When the issue first came to light?
parts.note: issue is offspring, and a child first sees daylight when it is born, though the surface suggests a problem becoming known

explanation.surface: A question about when a matter was first revealed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'issue' reads as a matter in dispute, but in law and old usage it means children.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby first sees the light of day at the moment it is born.

clue.text: American city, fashionable in the past

parts.note: chic means stylish or fashionable
ago means in the past, as in long ago

explanation.surface: A US city was stylish once upon a time.
explanation.definitionFit: The great city on Lake Michigan in Illinois is an American city.

clue.text: Eastern agents in biological group

parts.note: reps, short for representatives, are sales agents
taken as written

explanation.surface: Agents from the east join a biology team.
explanation.definitionFit: Erepsin is a mixture of enzymes in intestinal juice, a group of digestive proteins.

clue.text: Try moving in different directions to find plastic component

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the compass points

parts.note: S, E, N and E are the abbreviations for the compass points south, east, north and east

indicators.note: moving says the letters of try shift into a new order

explanation.surface: Searching all over to locate a part for something made of plastic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different directions' gives four compass points, S, E, N, E; 'moving' rearranges the three letters of the trial word to TYR, and 'in' sets them after the first point.
explanation.definitionFit: Styrene is the liquid hydrocarbon from which polystyrene is made, so it is a building block of that plastic.
